from __future__ import annotations
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

repo = Path.cwd().resolve()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\"ephi-u3-wheel-smoke-\") as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary)
    wheelhouse = root / \"wheelhouse\"
    wheelhouse.mkdir()
    build = subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"pip\", \"wheel\", \"--no-deps\", \"--wheel-dir\", str(wheelhouse), str(repo)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert build.returncode == 0, \"wheel build failed\"
    wheels = list(wheelhouse.glob(\"ephi-*.whl\"))
    assert len(wheels) == 1
    venv = root / \"venv\"
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, \"-m\", \"venv\", str(venv)], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True)
    python = venv / \"bin\" / \"python\"
    install = subprocess.run([str(python), \"-m\", \"pip\", \"install\", \"--no-deps\", str(wheels[0])], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert install.returncode == 0, \"wheel install failed\"
    cli = venv / \"bin\" / \"ephi-db-migrate\"
    plan = subprocess.run([str(cli), \"identity\"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert plan.returncode == 0, \"installed identity command failed\"
    report = json.loads(plan.stdout)
    assert (report[\"migration_count\"], report[\"identity_sha256\"]) == (11, \"c661c7a41eae8cd2b637778998bee77b8ebdec4a2ef78639d3ed7f69b23b1e8b\")
    location = subprocess.run([str(python), \"-c\", \"import ephi; print(ephi.__file__)\"], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
    assert str(repo / \"src\") not in location
    print(json.dumps({\"status\": \"PASS\", \"installed_wheel\": True, \"installed_migration_count\": report[\"migration_count\"], \"migration_identity_sha256\": report[\"identity_sha256\"], \"import_authority\": \"installed_venv\"}, sort_keys=True))
PY"
